properties.sfomuseum:description: Handwritten letter from Charles A. Lindbergh to Harold M. Bixby dated March 26, 1927; on stationery from Ryan Airlines; text refers to motor noted in 2019.121.0820 with further detail: combination J.4 and J.1 Whirlwind with J.1 crankcase and cylinders, recently overhauled; includes progress report on “our monoplane”, the Spirit of St. Louis.
